system.description:
By levying the weight and tension brought on by the chain and the weapon your mastery over the flail allows you to change and react to the weapons path by flicking your wrist and altering its course in a dozen micro movements.

Select a creature within range and make 4 melee taijutsu attacks against them with lightning swift strikes that crackle like lightning and boom like thunder dealing your [Weapons damage] + 1d12. Count every successful hit after the first. The affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Bruised.

Chain 2: If any attack scores a critical hit the affected creature is knocked Prone.

Chain 3: For each successful hit, you gain a +10-movement speed bonus and you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank you can make 1 additional attack as part of this jutsu’s casting.
